votes.motion: Authorize Tom's motion to sign the Proctor Trust consent document for the board's approval transferring the trust to the Community Foundation.

votes.motion: Open the warrant for the November 30 Special Town Meeting.
votes.quote: dave motion to open the warrant for the november 30% special town meeting tonight, steve seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Close the Special Town Meeting warrant at 5:00 PM on October 18, 2010.
votes.quote: tom move to close the warrant at 5:00 pm on october 18, 2010, steve seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Recommend a yes vote on State Ballot Question 1 (sales tax on alcoholic beverages).
votes.quote: as all three of these ballot questions affect the town the board voted unanimously to recommend a "yes" vote on question #1.

votes.motion: Board position on State Ballot Question 2 (Chapter 40B), printed as 'repeal Question #2' (support for the repeal of 40B).
votes.quote: board voted unanimously to repeal question #2.

votes.motion: Recommend a no vote on State Ballot Question 3 (sales and use tax rate reduction to 3%).
votes.moved_by: Tom and Steve concurred (no mover printed)
votes.quote: tom and steve also concurred and voted unanimously for a "no" vote on question #3.

votes.motion: Appoint Kiirja Paananen and Caroline Griffis to the Cultural Council (motion as printed reads only 'to appoint').
votes.quote: tom move to appoint, steve seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Approve appointing Kiirja Paananen to the Cultural Council.
votes.quote: tom motion to approve appointing kiirja, steve seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Adjourn the Regular Session at 8:28 P.M.
votes.quote: board voted unanimously to adjourn regular session at 8:28 p.m.

votes.motion: Enter Executive Session under MGL Chapter 39, §23B(3) for contract deliberations, with no return to Regular Session.
votes.quote: opened executive session by roll call vote; steve aye, tom aye, paula aye, and dave aye
